proofUses.reason: Condition on the green-connected set, apply BK in its complement, then use bounded convergence of indicators rather than a false monotonicity claim.
The cutting identity retains the correct conditional coordinates. The signed deletion loss is bounded before enlarging its indicator. A positive part makes the triangle-size qualification explicit.
The completed bootstrap controls the nontrivial triangle and the edge mass. The coefficient tends to 1/(2e), yielding the stated uniform square-root bounds.
A two-field inequality gives explicit two-sided tail constants, including n=1. The lower constant in the manuscript calculation is corrected locally.
Only levels above the supercritical density are inverted. A bi-Lipschitz coordinate change and Fubini justify integration of the almost-everywhere differential inequality along levels.
The density comparison retains 2d and is clipped at one for the full parameter interval. Both tail and rescaled density constants are uniform in sufficiently large dimension.
The nontrivial triangle is bounded by three weighted triangles; the explicit critical bound supplies the neighbouring-triangle hypothesis and the susceptibility comparison.
An explicit exponential-series comparison makes the field coefficient at least 2/11; integration, tail comparison and valid-level extrapolation give uniform numerical mean-field bounds.

The small triangle and exploration score give the cubic lower moment with constant 1/3. A size-biased band and an intermediate subcritical parameter give the lower cutoff, while the weighted exponential estimate supplies the upper tail.
